prompt.text: Set up your photos using Open paper tutor above the notebook, then each person types ready here. The 20-minute paper phase starts only when everyone is ready.

Phase 1 has started (20 minutes). Work on the notebook problem on paper. Use Open paper tutor at the top for photos and private feedback. When ready, each person types paper done here. Wait for Phase 2 before coding.

Phase 2 starts now: coding (25 minutes). Camera capture stops automatically at this transition. A worked paper solution is now shown in the notebook. Compare it with your work, then implement recover_readings(recorded). In a group, take turns editing the notebook. Wait for autosave before running the check and keep the supplied cell tags. After the latest check passes, each person types coding done here when ready, or coding not done to withdraw readiness.

The coding phase has ended. Wait for the notebook to autosave, including any unfinished code. One person should run the submission cell. It uses your room account if you are alone; in a group, choose your account from the list it shows. After receiving a submission ID, type submitted here. The bot will verify that the submission was stored. Keep the ID as your confirmation.
Your notebook submission is stored. Keep your submission ID and paper notes. The instructor can see the final grade. This concludes the activity.
